title: WHO Group A, B, and C drugs
dek: 2022 grouping: A is Lfx/Mfx, BDQ, LZD. B is CFZ and CS/terizidone. C is the rest, ordered. Group letters moved; read the year.
story: When BPaLM/BPaL or a 6/9-month standardised oral regimen is not possible, WHO still builds longer individualised regimens from grouped drugs. Group A (later-generation FQ, bedaquiline, linezolid) should be used unless a drug is compromised. Group B (clofazimine, cycloserine/terizidone) fills next. Group C is ranked: EMB, DLM, PZA, AMK, (ETH/PTO), (MER/IMI+clavulanate), (PAS), with injectables and PAS as last-ish.
This is not the 2016 grouping (where injectables sat higher). Citing “Group 5” from a 2011 paper is archaeology. Pretomanid lives in BPaLM/BPaL, not as a free Group C Lego in every longer recipe.
Resistance to a Group A drug is how 2021-XDR is defined (FQ plus BDQ or LZD on an MDR/RR backbone). The grouping is therefore both a construction kit and a surveillance language.
deepTitle: How to build without a meme
deep: Aim for at least four likely-effective drugs in the intensive construction; WHO’s current handbook is the count authority, not this sentence.
Do not add two FQs. Do not add AMK if rrs 1401 is there “for luck.”
Delamanid in Group C versus in BDLLfxC is a regimen-context switch, not a new molecule.
Pediatric and pregnancy rankings differ (Pa off; AMK off; Eto off). The group table is adult-ish until the handbook says otherwise.

visual.caption: 2022 WHO groups for longer DR-TB construction. A before B before C. Injectables are C, not a definition of XDR.

example.title: FQ-R, LZD-intolerant, Pa off
example.setup: Pregnant, gyrA D94G, LZD neuropathy at week 3, BDQ still good.

steps.title: BPaLM is already illegal here
steps.body: Pa off; M is lost to FQ-R.

steps.title: BDLLfxC then drop Lfx
steps.body: BDLC (BDQ, DLM, LZD, CFZ) — but LZD is failing clinically.

steps.title: Individualise from groups
steps.body: Keep BDQ (A), add CFZ (B), DLM (C), maybe CS if psychiatric screen allows; do not resurrect KM because the word XDR feels old.

example.takeaway: Groups are a construction order after the 6-month acronyms fail.

check.why: Those three are the backbone of both acronyms and 2021-XDR.

whyWrong.KM, CM, AMK: Old second-line injectables, now Group C/historical.

check.prompt: 2021 XDR requires resistance to MDR/RR + FQ plus:
choices: At least one of BDQ or LZD (Group A companions)
check.answer: At least one of BDQ or LZD (Group A companions)
check.why: FQ is already the pre-XDR step; XDR adds the other Group A drug class used as BDQ or LZD.
